Our headliner today is the latest 48-hour EcoFlow flash sale, which has offers like the TITAN 5000 Classic Power Station with 4x 175W rigid solar panels down at a $2,707 low , and others from $899. Hiboy is currently offering up to 45% Black Friday savings on EVs starting from $300 , while Worx’s newest 40V Trivac 3-in-1 Leaf Blower, Vacuum, and Mulcher is down at a $200 low . There’s also the 50% discount on Greenworks’ 80V 4.0Ah Gen2 Battery, a deal for Aiper’s HydroSync 5-in-1 Smart Pool Monitor, and more below. At the bottom of the page, you can find yesterday’s deals, including the Anker SOLIX S5000 power station deals with up to $2,380 exclusive savings, the Navee Early Access Black Friday EV Sale lineup, and others.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
EcoFlow flash sale offers TITAN 5000 Classic power station + 4x 175W rigid solar panels at $2,707 low ($1,588 off), more
As part of the ongoing EcoFlow Early Black Friday Sale , we’re getting another 48-hour period of flash deals, one of which is the new TITAN 5000 Classic Power Station with 4x 175W rigid solar panels down at $2,706.55 shipped , after using the code EFTITANAFF at checkout (active for all TITAN purchases), with the closest match at Amazon being a bundle with 4x 160W solar panels $292 higher in price . Down from $4,295, this is the very first deal we’re seeing on this particular bundle, which is a more semi-permanent/permanent setup to be used at a fixed location like your home. Initially you get a cut down to $2,849, but thanks to the still-active launch code things drop further to this rate. That means you’re getting a massive, combined $1,588 markdown for a new all-time low price, or the standalone TITAN 5000 Classic can be yours at $2,374.05 shipped , after using the above code. Head below to check out the full lineup of deals while they last.
***Note: While extra savings codes typically do not stack with flash savings, the TITAN 5000 Classic deal is getting the rare opportunity to benefit from its ongoing launch code EFTITANAFF taking an extra 5% off the cost. Be sure to use it for the bundle or any other TITAN purchases to get the biggest deals!

Hiboy’s beginner-friendly EX6 e-bike offers up to 75-mile travel down at $900 ($200 off), more from $300
Hiboy has its Black Friday EV Sale in full swing , as well as some Amazon discounts right now , too, taking up to 44% off select models, like the EX6 Step-Thru Fat Tire e-bike down at $899.99 shipped , which is out of stock at Amazon . While it may carry a $1,580 MSRP, it only ever goes as high as $1,100 these days, with discounts having consistently dropped the cost down to this rate over the year, save for one fall lower to $700 that occurred for a few hours in April. The deal here gives you $200 off the going rate, landing it at the second-best price of 2026.
You can browse the full Hiboy Black Friday Sale lineup here .
Newest Worx 40V Trivac 3-in-1 cordless leaf blower, vac, and mulcher hits $200 low
Amazon is currently offering the latest Worx 40V Trivac 3-in-1 600 CFM Cordless Leaf Blower, Vacuum, and Mulcher (tool only) down at $199.99 shipped . As I said, this is a newer model that has only been on the market for three months with a $230 full price, with only some first-time discounts spotted on its 2x battery and 4x battery packages in October, the latter currently being $30 off. This is the first deal we’ve spotted on just the tool, with the $30 cut from the tag for a new low. Of course, you can also find the popular corded 350 CFM Trivac predecessor at its third-lowest annual price of $69.99 shipped .
Power your 80V Greenworks arsenal with this 4.0Ah Gen2 battery down at a $146 Amazon low (Reg. up to $290)
Amazon is currently offering the Greenworks 80V 4.0Ah Gen2 Battery down at $145.99 shipped , with some other battery sizes available on the same page. Down from $290, it was mostly discounted between $190 and $180 in 2026, though we did see it previously go as low as $174. Now, though, you’re getting a larger 50% markdown for $144 savings, landing it at the best price we have tracked at Amazon. Likewise, you can find the 80V 2.0Ah Gen2 counterpart down at $111.99 shipped right now, too.
Aiper’s HydroSync upgrades your pool with solar-powered 5-in-1 testing at $280 (Reg. $360)
Through its official Amazon storefront, Aiper is offering its HydroSync 5-in-1 Smart Pool Monitor down at $279.99 shipped in either blue or white colorways. While charts may show it falling from $600 here, the device actually carries a $360 MSRP, with discounts this year having taken things down as low as $250 back in June. Since then, it’s been consistently seen down at this rate, which gives you an $80 markdown for the third-lowest price we have tracked. You can find more of the brand’s robot pool cleaner and smart irrigation deals here .
Velotric’s premium Discover M mid-drive e-bike boasts multi-terrain build and FREE bag at new $2,399 low
Anker’s Black Friday security sale cuts $700 off triple-lens solar 4-cam kit with up to 16TB HomeBase S1, much more
